extracted_claim: EnTT v4.0 uses sparse_set + packed_array architecture. ENTT_ID_TYPE defaults to uint32_t. ENTT_SPARSE_PAGE=4096, ENTT_PACKED_PAGE=1024. Entity = index + version (generation). basic_any<Len, Align> provides type-erased storage with policies: empty, dynamic, embedded, ref, cref. dense_map provides fast key-value storage. Registry creates/destroys entities and manages component storage.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no ECS. EnTT is the leading C++ ECS library.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE uses OOP scene graph, not ECS

topic: EnTT Component Pools and Type Erasure
extracted_claim: EnTT component pools use compressed_pair for EBO (empty base optimization). Type identity used for compile-time type queries. type_list provides compile-time type manipulation (concat, unique, diff, transform). value_list provides compile-time value lists. any_policy enum controls storage mode. ENTT_NO_ETO disables embedded type optimization. ENTT_NO_MIXIN disables storage mixins.
implementation_relevance: Understanding EnTT's type erasure helps design HSE's component system if adopting ECS.
